Checkly | https://www.checklyhq.com | Senior Product Engineer, Product Manager, Senior Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer | REMOTE (Europe / US Eastern) | Full-time

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken. They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Open roles:

- Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability) - remote, UTC-3 to UTC+3 - Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability) - remote UTC-3 to UTC+3 - Senior Sales Engineer - remote Europe (UTC+1 to UTC+2) - Sales Engineer - remote US, Eastern time zone

All roles, compensation and applications: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/checkly?utm_source=hn
